about: Stretches of track with a view on one side (js/sides.js), built by scripts/build_views.py; entries marked hand were drawn by hand. line runs along the track ([lon, lat]). side is where the view is traveling the way the line is drawn, facing forward; toward is what the view looks out on, from which the side is worked out. minKm: how far along it a ride must go (5 unless given). night: worth it after dark.
